nodes.description: address public owner in Owned; set to msg.sender in constructor and checked in onlyOwner.
address public newOwner in Owned; pending owner used by two-step ownership transfer.
string public symbol of FHCContract, set to 'FHC'.
string public name of FHCContract, set to 'Future Health'.
uint8 public decimals, set to 18.
uint public _totalSupply, total token supply assigned to the deployer address.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure; unchecked addition followed by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure; require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure; unchecked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure; require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; sets pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner.
FHCContract() constructor; initializes token metadata, total supply and allocates all tokens to a hardcoded address.
totalSupply() public constant; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant; returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; debits balances and allowed, credits recipient.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant; returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external, state not finalized).
function () public payable; unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; external call to arbitrary token contract sending tokens to owner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership and allowance keys.
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after allowance write, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract address.

Unchecked subtraction c = a - b in safeSub (pre-0.8 arithmetic).
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b in safeMul (pre-0.8 arithmetic).
Unchecked division c = a / b in safeDiv (pre-0.8 arithmetic).
